summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.81/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.81 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 9, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 8. AAA figures put the statewide average 31¢ lower than a week ago, 23¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.07 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Janesville ($3.59) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.14).
